feeds.title: Wood Workers Institute | Woodturning Blog
feeds.description: The Woodworkers Institute brings you latest news and equipment tests, projects and techniques plus blogs and an active community of woodworkers all from the home of the UKs best Woodworking magazines.

feeds.title: Mortise & Tenon Magazine Blog
feeds.description: M&T brings readers a wide variety of content. We believe a full appreciation of period furniture making practice comes from an integrative approach where your mind is as engaged as your hands are in learning.

feeds.title: Turn A Wood Bowl
feeds.description: Turn A Wood Bowl is dedicated to the skill and art of the woodturned bowl. Learn details on how to turn a wood bowl from beginning to finished wooden.

feeds.title: As Wood Turns
feeds.description: I'm pursuing a dream. I've enjoyed woodturning for many years but work, family, and other necessaries have prevented fulfillment. I'm now reaching for the dream. I share my journey and progress so that others may also turn dream into beauty.

feeds.title: Colin Norgate Blog
feeds.description: Colin Norgate is a designer and maker of exquisite furniture and objects in wood.

feeds.title: Michael Sinclair Woodturner Blog
feeds.description: Woodturner Michael Sinclair's gallery in Harray Orkney and online shop selling bowls turned in Scottish hardwoods ash, yew, sycamore, oak and beech.

feeds.title: Milwaukee Area Woodturners Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to promote the craft and artistry of woodturning and provide members a place to share their knowledge, enhance and improve their skills, and to enjoy the fellowship of other woodturners.

feeds.title: Channel Islands Woodturners Blog
feeds.description: The mission of Channel Islands Woodturners, Inc. is to promote education and awareness of the art and craft of woodturning among the membership and the general public; and to provide opportunities for youth and adults to safely learn woodturning techniques, acquire artistic values, and increase experience and skill.

feeds.title: First State Woodturners Blog
feeds.description: The Club provides a place for area woodturners to meet regularly, show their recent work, learn new techniques, and discuss various aspects of woodturning. We have lathes available, and experienced turners to demonstrate safe procedures and techniques.

feeds.title: Glenn Lucas Blog
feeds.description: Group lessons or individual courses in woodturning native Irish wood into bowls and functional ware. Classes for beginners interested in woodwork.

feeds.title: Adventures In Turning
feeds.description: Tom is an amateur woodworker, and more recently woodturner. This blog is dedicated to my love of all things wooden, and my journey from complete novice to whichever stage I reach as a woodturner.

feeds.title: Duncan Clark Woodturning Blog
feeds.description: Duncan Clark created this site to share his passion for wood and its use in everyday objects. Blog posts cover woodturning, bowl making, natural edge vase, spalted birch, and wellingtonia fir.

feeds.title: Woodturning by Terry Vaughan Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my website! My name is Terry Vaughan, and I live and work in North London. I've turned wood for over 40 years, and now that I have retired from my day job I find it's taking up more of my time. My workshop studio is filled with ever-accumulating shavings, timber, part-finished bowls and the tools I need for my work.

feeds.title: Artistry In Wood
feeds.description: George is a professional woodturner based in Burnham-on-Sea, Somerset, where he creates a vast range of high quality products from pens, bowls, platters to wall and garden sculptures, from locally sourced native timbers. Texture and colour feature prominently in his work resulting with George producing practical, beautifully made work perfect for the home and garden.

feeds.title: Willow Works Wood Turning
feeds.description: A Woodturning blog. Find wood Artistry Of Alan Willoughby.

feeds.title: Gary @ Hugo's Woodshop Blog
feeds.description: I am an accountant who uses woodwork as a way to escape computers. I work in the back half of a tandem garage under the house; effectively a basement that also houses my wife's car. I have a reasonable set of tools and am getting more into hand tools, mainly due to the lack of noise and dust minimization.

feeds.title: Red Rose Woodturning Club
feeds.description: The main purpose of the club is to foster interest in woodturning and to help members improve their skill in a friendly and sociable atmosphere.

feeds.title: Carter and Son Toolworks - Woodturning : Articles, Tips & Ideas Blog
feeds.description: Carter and Son Toolworks, based out of Seattle Washington, is a woodturning tool manufacturer. We love woodturning and we manufacture the very best woodturning tools.

feeds.title: The Walnut Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning fine woodworker, Andrew Potocnik is a renowned Australian woodworker who works with recycled and salvaged timber.

feeds.title: Paolo Ceresi Woodturning
feeds.description: A Woodturning blog.

feeds.title: Grieves Wood Turning Blog
feeds.description: We are a Leicestershire, Rutland and Scotland based carpentry business who specialises in hand crafted products turned on are own wood lathes.

feeds.title: Bill's Blog
feeds.description: A woodturning blog

feeds.title: Jim Lorriman Woodturner Blog
feeds.description: I am a self-taught woodworker and turner. I have been operating as a full-time bowl turner for the last 20 years at my studio in the Mulmur Hills near Mansfield, Ontario.

feeds.title: Robert O Connor
feeds.description: Welcome to Robert O'Connor The Woodturning Studio Multi award winning Robert O Connor is regarded as one of the finest woodturners in Ireland crafting unique wooden pieces for over 25 years. All our pieces are hand-turned from locally sourced timber.

feeds.title: Thewoodturning.com Blog
feeds.description: The site would guide you on matters such as the right use of woodturning tools, how to shape wood, which is the best tool for turning, and what tools are necessary for woodturning. Likewise, the site helps you in picking up the best woodturning tool as a beginner or as an expert.

feeds.title: Harvey Tools
feeds.description: Harvey is dedicated to high quality machines in not only woodworking but other fields too. Check out our T40 Wood Lathe and our Gyro Air Dust Collector!

feeds.title: David Munyak Blog
feeds.description: Woodturning is about curves and curves fascinate me. A beautiful curve can give a sense of movement to a static object, creating a sudden feeling of tension in the observer and releasing it just as quickly. I strive to incorporate these qualities into my work.

feeds.title: Jonathan Leech Blog
feeds.description: Jonathan has a passion for working with wood, expressing its beauty within a contemporary design. Hand turned wooden bowls, beautifully crafted from sustainably sourced timber. Each bowl has a natural beauty that is truly unique.
